SA-ea9ddd7d5e60c006.quote: PARIS, 6 October 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wiremind today announced it has raised €35 million from three new investors: IronWave (formerly Wendel Growth), Bpifrance Investissement (via its Large Venture fund) and Seaya Andromeda. Co-founders Colin Girault-Matz (CEO) and Charles Pierre (CTO) remain majority shareholders and retain control of the business.
